acceptedAnswer.text: The best time to start a kitchen remodel in Albany or El Cerrito often depends on your personal schedule and preferences. Many homeowners prefer to start in late spring or early fall to avoid peak holiday seasons and take advantage of milder weather for any work that might require open windows or temporary outdoor access. However, we work year-round, and our team can accommodate projects in any season.
